commonPrefix: Use the prefix preceding Animation: in WALK_FORWARD from prompts.json, followed by the applicable animation below.

animations.HEAVY_KICK: Animation: 12-frame powerful HIGH SIDE KICK toward RIGHT. Frame1 guard,2 weight shift onto leftward support leg,3 draw rightward knee high,4 rotate hip,5-6 fully extend kicking leg horizontally to RIGHT at upper-chest height,7 follow-through,8 bend knee back into chamber,9 lower foot,10-12 recover guard. Keep upper body leaning left as counterweight, two hands guarding, exactly two legs, leg NOT joined to arm. The entire outstretched shoe and long hair must fit with generous padding; no cropping.
animations.BLOCK: Animation: 12-frame transition into defensive HIGH BLOCK facing RIGHT. Frame1 normal guard,2-4 progressively raise both forearms together in front of face and upper chest,5-8 brace with elbows bent and knees slightly bent,9-12 maintain strong closed defensive guard with small breathing motions. Final frame remains BLOCKING, not idle. Both forearms visible, fists closed, no shields, no armor, no effects. Feet stay planted at same baseline.
animations.HIT_REACTION: Animation: 12-frame non-graphic light-hit reaction facing RIGHT, no injury or blood. Frame1 standing guard,2 head flinches back toward left,3-4 shoulders recoil left and torso arches slightly,5-6 weight moves to rear leg,7-9 recover balance,10-12 return to guard. Glasses remain firmly on face. Hands open slightly from impact then close into fists. Feet stay on baseline, do not fall down.
animations.KNOCKDOWN: Animation: 12-frame non-graphic backward knockdown caused by a hit from RIGHT. Frame1 standing guard facing right,2 recoil shoulders left,3 knees buckle,4-5 body tilts and falls backward toward LEFT,6-7 hips near ground and legs forward to right,8 lands sitting/backward,9 rolls onto side/back,10-12 rests lying horizontally on ground with head to LEFT and feet to RIGHT. Final frame is prone, NOT standing. No blood, no opponent, no effects. Fixed body scale, do NOT enlarge the prone body. Full prone figure fits entirely in the square cell with clear padding; baseline at88%.
animations.GET_UP: Animation: 12-frame GETTING UP from the floor facing RIGHT. Frame1 lying on back/side with HEAD to LEFT and feet to RIGHT, frame2 roll to side,3 prop torso on elbow,4-5 push to sitting,6 plant one hand and front foot,7 come onto one knee,8-9 rise from kneeling,10 nearly upright,11-12 return to standing fighting guard. CRITICAL keep same body size from prone through standing, no scaling tiny-to-large. Baseline stays fixed, full head and shoes fit with padding. No blood.
animations.TAUNT: Animation: 12-frame playful confident taunt facing RIGHT. Frame1 fighting guard,2 relax shoulders,3 shift weight back,4-5 briefly adjust glasses with two fingertips of forward hand while other hand rests on hip,6-7 friendly confident smirk,8 release glasses,9-10 bring hands back up,11-12 fighting guard. Same glasses stay on face, no rude gestures, no text.
animations.VICTORY: Animation: 12-frame celebratory victory pose cycle. Frame1 relaxed fighting guard facing RIGHT,2-3 straighten posture,4-5 raise forward clenched fist to shoulder,6-8 raise fist triumphantly just above head and smile,9-10 lower fist slightly,11-12 settle back to proud relaxed guard. Keep raised hand fully inside each cell with ample top padding; use same standing body scale, do not shrink the character when arm raised. No confetti or text.
animations.DEFEAT: Animation: 12-frame defeated, exhausted non-graphic pose. Frame1 standing guard facing RIGHT,2-3 shoulders sink and knees bend,4-5 lower onto one knee,6-7 sit back on heel with head bowed,8-9 settle on both knees,10-12 hold exhausted kneeling pose with one hand on ground and other resting on thigh, head bowed but glasses remain on face. No blood, no wounds, no tears, no opponent. Keep same body scale throughout, head genuinely lowers with knees; final pose does NOT stand.
animations.SPECIAL_ATTACK: Animation: 12-frame powerful rising UPPERCUT special attack toward RIGHT. Frame1 guard,2-3 deep crouched windup with rear fist near hip,4 drive upward from legs,5-6 forceful rising bent-arm uppercut fist aimed diagonally UP-RIGHT,7 fully extended rising punch with small cyan arc closely tracing fist,8 retract elbow,9 lower body,10-12 settle back in guard. Small cyan energy accent only around impact fist, contained within its cell, no giant projectile. Exactly two arms, legs natural, same full body size and face.

DEFEAT_BACKGROUND_REFINEMENT: Use case: background-extraction. Edit this sprite sheet ONLY to REMOVE ALL the white/gray/colored background and drop shadows around every figure, including between limbs. Output genuine transparent PNG. Preserve all twelve original full-body woman sprites, their exact 4 columns x 3 rows layout, poses, pixel-art details, glasses, green shirts, blue jeans and beige sneakers unchanged. Every pixel outside the twelve character silhouettes must be fully transparent, including the entire top two rows. Do not replace with a solid color, do not add a checkerboard, do not add labels. Clean crisp alpha edges with no white, red or gray halos. Preserve every character outline, hair strand and shoe.
